description: List all Planner plans that the current user is a member of
examples: Show me all my Planner plans
What plans do I have in Planner?
List my plans
notes: Plans are owned by Microsoft 365 Groups -- the owner field is a group ID.

description: Get a specific Planner plan by its ID
examples: Show me the details of plan {planId}
Get my 'Sprint 42' plan
Open the project plan
notes: Plans are owned by Microsoft 365 Groups -- the owner field is a group ID.

description: Get the details of a Planner plan including category descriptions
examples: Show me the plan details for plan {planId}
What are the category labels for this plan?
Get the full details of the project plan

description: List all buckets in a Planner plan
examples: Show me the buckets in plan {planId}
What columns does my plan have?
List buckets for the project plan

description: Create a new bucket in a Planner plan
examples: Create a bucket called 'In Progress' in my plan
Add a new column named 'Backlog' to the plan
Make a bucket for 'Testing'
Rename the 'To Do' bucket to 'Backlog'
Change the bucket name to 'In Review'
Update bucket {bucketId} name
notes: ALL PATCH operations require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET request. Get the ETag from the @odata.etag property of the bucket object.

description: Delete a bucket from a Planner plan
examples: Delete the 'Archive' bucket
Remove bucket {bucketId}
Get rid of the 'Old Items' column
notes: ALL DELETE operations on Planner resources require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET request.

description: List all tasks in a Planner plan
examples: Show me all tasks in the project plan
List tasks in plan {planId}
What tasks are in this plan?

description: List all tasks in a specific Planner bucket
examples: Show me tasks in the 'In Progress' bucket
What tasks are in bucket {bucketId}?
List items in the 'To Do' column

description: Get a specific Planner task by its ID
examples: Show me the details of Planner task {taskId}
Get the 'Design mockups' task
What are the details of that Planner task?
notes: The response includes the @odata.etag property needed for any subsequent PATCH or DELETE operations.

description: Get the details of a Planner task including its description and checklist items
examples: Show me the description and checklist for task {taskId}
Get the full details of that Planner task
What's in the checklist for this task?
notes: Task details (description, checklist) are at a separate endpoint: /planner/tasks/{id}/details. The checklist is a dictionary keyed by GUIDs.

description: Create a new task in a Planner plan and bucket
examples: Create a task called 'Design homepage' in the project plan
Add a Planner task to the 'To Do' bucket
Make a new task in plan {planId}

description: Create a new Planner task with assignments and a due date
examples: Create a Planner task 'Write proposal' assigned to John due next Friday
Add a task with assignments and a deadline
Create a task assigned to {userId} in the project plan
notes: Assignments use a userId-keyed object: { assignments: { 'user-id': { '@odata.type': '#microsoft.graph.plannerAssignment', 'orderHint': ' !' } } }. dueDateTime is an ISO 8601 string (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z').

description: Update a Planner task's title, due date, progress, or bucket
examples: Change the due date of Planner task {taskId}
Move the task to the 'In Progress' bucket
Update the title of the Planner task
notes: ALL PATCH operations require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET request. Get the ETag from the @odata.etag property of the task object. Include only the fields you want to update. percentComplete values: 0 (not started), 25, 50, 75, 100 (complete).

description: Mark a Planner task as complete by setting percentComplete to 100
examples: Complete the 'Design mockups' Planner task
Mark Planner task {taskId} as done
Set the task to 100% complete
notes: ALL PATCH operations require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET request. Get the ETag from the @odata.etag property of the task object. percentComplete values: 0 (not started), 25, 50, 75, 100 (complete).

description: Update the details of a Planner task including description and checklist items
examples: Add a description to Planner task {taskId}
Update the checklist on my Planner task
Set the task description to 'Review all PR comments'
notes: Task details (description, checklist) are at a separate endpoint: /planner/tasks/{id}/details. ALL PATCH operations require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET on the task details. Checklist items are keyed by GUIDs that you generate.

examples: Delete Planner task {taskId}
Remove the 'Old design' task from the plan
Get rid of that Planner task
notes: ALL DELETE operations require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET request. Get the ETag from the @odata.etag property of the task object.

description: Assign a Planner task to a user
examples: Assign task {taskId} to John
Add {userId} to the task
Give this task to Sarah
notes: ALL PATCH operations require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET request. Assignments use a userId-keyed object: { assignments: { 'user-id': { '@odata.type': '#microsoft.graph.plannerAssignment', 'orderHint': ' !' } } }. New assignments are merged with existing ones.

description: Remove a user's assignment from a Planner task
examples: Unassign John from task {taskId}
Remove {userId} from the task
Take Sarah off this task
notes: ALL PATCH operations require an If-Match header with the ETag from a prior GET request. Set the user's assignment to null to unassign them.
